```julia
module AlleleFrequencyChannel

using ProtoBuf

struct AlleleFrequencyChannel <: Channel
    width::Int
    options::PileupImageOptions
    allele_frequency_color::Union{UInt8, Nothing}
end

function AlleleFrequencyChannel(width::Int, options::PileupImageOptions)
    return AlleleFrequencyChannel(width, options, nothing)
end

function FillReadBase(channel::AlleleFrequencyChannel, data::Vector{UInt8}, col::Int, read_base::Char, ref_base::Char, base_quality::Int, read::Read, read_index::Int, dv_call::DeepVariantCall, alt_alleles::Vector{String})
    allele_frequency = ReadAlleleFrequency(channel, dv_call, read, alt_alleles)
    color = AlleleFrequencyColor(channel, allele_frequency)
    channel.allele_frequency_color = color
    data[col + 1] = color
end

function FillRefBase(channel::AlleleFrequencyChannel, ref_data::Vector{UInt8}, col::Int, ref_base::Char, ref_bases::String)
    ref_data[col + 1] = UInt8(0)
end

function ReadAlleleFrequency(channel::AlleleFrequencyChannel, dv_call::DeepVariantCall, read::Read, alt_alleles::AbstractVector{String})
    if !haskey(dv_call.info, "AF")
        return 0.0f0
    end
    af_field = dv_call.info["AF"]
    if length(af_field.values) == 0
        return 0.0f0
    end
    return af_field.values[1].number_value
end

function AlleleFrequencyColor(channel::AlleleFrequencyChannel, allele_frequency::Float32)
    return UInt8(round(allele_frequency * 254.0f0) + 1)
end

end
```

```julia
using Logging

struct Variant
    reference_name::String
    start::Int
    end::Int
    reference_bases::String
    alternate_bases::Vector{String}
    info::Dict{String, Any}
end

struct DeepVariantCall
    variant::Variant
    allele_support::Any
    allele_frequency::Dict{String, Float64}
end

struct IndexedFastaReader
    data::Dict{String, String}
end

function IndexedFastaReader(data::Dict{String, String})
    return IndexedFastaReader(data)
end

function query(reader::IndexedFastaReader, region::NamedTuple{(:reference_name, :start, :end), Tuple{String, Int, Int}})
    chrom = region.reference_name
    start_pos = region.start
    end_pos = region.end
    if haskey(reader.data, chrom)
        sequence = reader.data[chrom]
        if 1 <= start_pos <= end_pos <= length(sequence)
            return sequence[start_pos:end_pos]
        end
    end
    return ""
end

function is_valid(reader::IndexedFastaReader, region::NamedTuple{(:reference_name, :start, :end), Tuple{String, Int, Int}})
    chrom = region.reference_name
    start_pos = region.start
    end_pos = region.end
    if haskey(reader.data, chrom)
        sequence = reader.data[chrom]
        return 1 <= start_pos <= end_pos <= length(sequence)
    end
    return false
end

struct VcfReader
    filename::String
    header::Any
    variants::Vector{Variant}
end

function VcfReader(filename::String; header=nothing)
    variants = Vector{Variant}()
    open(filename, "r") do file
        while !eof(file)
            line = readline(file)
            if !startswith(line, "#")
                parts = split(line, '\t')
                if length(parts) >= 5
                    chrom = parts[1]
                    pos = parse(Int, parts[2])
                    ref = parts[4]
                    alts = split(parts[5], ',')
                    info_dict = Dict{String, Any}()
                    if length(parts) >= 8
                        info_parts = split(parts[8], ';')
                        for info_part in info_parts
                            if occursin("=", info_part)
                                key, val = split(info_part, '=')
                                if key == "AF"
                                    vals = split(val, ',')
                                    numbers = Float64[]
                                    for v in vals
                                        push!(numbers, parse(Float64, v))
                                    end
                                    info_dict[key] = (values=[(number_value=x) for x in numbers],)
                                else
                                    info_dict[key] = val
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    variant_end = pos + length(ref)
                    variant = Variant(chrom, pos, variant_end, ref, alts, info_dict)
                    push!(variants, variant)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return VcfReader(filename, header, variants)
end

function query(reader::VcfReader, region::NamedTuple{(:reference_name, :start, :end), Tuple{String, Int, Int}})
    matching_variants = Vector{Variant}()
    for variant in reader.variants
        if variant.reference_name == region.reference_name
            if variant.start <= region.end && variant.end >= region.start
                push!(matching_variants, variant)
            end
        end
    end
    return matching_variants
end

function iterate(reader::VcfReader)
    if isempty(reader.variants)
        return nothing
    end
    return (reader.variants[1], 2)
end

function iterate(reader::VcfReader, state::Int)
    if state > length(reader.variants)
        return nothing
    end
    return (reader.variants[state], state + 1)
end

function get_allele_frequency(variant::Variant, index::Int)
    if haskey(variant.info, "AF")
        af_info = variant.info["AF"]
        if index < length(af_info.values)
            return af_info.values[index + 1].number_value
        else
            throw(ArgumentError("Invalid index $index for the info[AF] field $(af_info.values)"))
        end
    end
    throw(ArgumentError("Variant does not have an AF field"))
end

function get_ref_allele_frequency(variant::Variant)
    sum_alt_frequency = 0.0
    for (alt_idx, _) in enumerate(variant.alternate_bases)
        sum_alt_frequency += get_allele_frequency(variant, alt_idx - 1)
    end
    return 1.0 - sum_alt_frequency
end

function make_range(reference_name::String, start::Int, end_pos::Int)
    return (reference_name=reference_name, start=start, end=end_pos)
end

function get_ref_haplotype_and_offset(dv_variant::Variant, cohort_variants::Vector{Variant}, ref_reader::IndexedFastaReader)
    if isempty(cohort_variants)
        min_start_position = dv_variant.start
        max_end_position = dv_variant.end
    else
        min_start_position = min(dv_variant.start, minimum([cv.start for cv in cohort_variants]))
        max_end_position = max(dv_variant.end, maximum([cv.end for cv in cohort_variants]))
    end

    haplotype_region = make_range(dv_variant.reference_name, min_start_position, max_end_position)

    if is_valid(ref_reader, haplotype_region)
        return query(ref_reader, haplotype_region), min_start_position
    else
        throw(ArgumentError("Invalid IndexedFastaReader region $haplotype_region"))
    end
end

function update_haplotype(variant::Variant, reference_haplotype::String, reference_offset::Int)
    if variant.start < reference_offset
        throw(ArgumentError("The starting position of a variant is smaller than its corresponding reference offset $(variant.start) $reference_offset"))
    end
    offset_start = variant.start - reference_offset + 1
    offset_suffix = variant.start + length(variant.reference_bases) - reference_offset + 1
    list_updated_haplotype = Vector{Dict{String, Any}}()
    for biallelic_variant in variant.alternate_bases
        prefix = offset_start > 1 ? reference_haplotype[1:offset_start-1] : ""
        suffix = offset_suffix <= length(reference_haplotype) ? reference_haplotype[offset_suffix:end] : ""
        updated_haplotype = prefix * biallelic_variant * suffix
        dict_haplotype = Dict{String, Any}(
            "haplotype" => updated_haplotype,
            "alt" => biallelic_variant,
            "variant" => variant
        )
        push!(list_updated_haplotype, dict_haplotype)
    end
    return list_updated_haplotype
end

function simplify_variant_alleles(variant::Variant)
    ref = variant.reference_bases
    start_pos = variant.start
    for alt in variant.alternate_bases
        i = 1
        while i <= min(length(ref), length(alt)) && ref[i] == alt[i]
            i += 1
        end
        if i > 1
            ref = ref[i:end]
            start_pos = variant.start + i - 1
        end
    end
    return Variant(variant.reference_name, start_pos, start_pos + length(ref), ref, variant.alternate_bases, variant.info)
end

function match_candidate_and_cohort_haplotypes(candidate_haps::Vector{Dict{String, Any}}, cohort_haps_and_freqs::Vector{Dict{String, Any}})
    dict_allele_frequency = Dict{String, Float64}()
    for candidate_obj in candidate_haps
        candidate_haplotype = candidate_obj["haplotype"]
        candidate_alt = candidate_obj["alt"]
        candidate_variant = candidate_obj["variant"]

        for cohort_obj in cohort_haps_and_freqs
            cohort_haplotype = cohort_obj["haplotype"]
            if candidate_haplotype == cohort_haplotype
                cohort_variant = cohort_obj["variant"]
                cohort_alt = cohort_obj["alt"]
                alt_index = findfirst(x -> x == cohort_alt, cohort_variant.alternate_bases)
                if alt_index !== nothing
                    cohort_frequency = get_allele_frequency(cohort_variant, alt_index - 1)
                    dict_allele_frequency[candidate_alt] = cohort_frequency
                end

                ref_allele = candidate_variant.reference_bases
                if !haskey(dict_allele_frequency, ref_allele)
                    dict_allele_frequency[ref_allele] = get_ref_allele_frequency(cohort_variant)
                end
            end
        end

        if !haskey(dict_allele_frequency, candidate_alt)
            dict_allele_frequency[candidate_alt] = 0.0
        end
    end

    if sum(values(dict_allele_frequency)) == 0.0
        candidate = candidate_haps[1]["variant"]
        s_candidate = simplify_variant_alleles(candidate)
        for cohort_obj in cohort_haps_and_freqs
            s_cohort_variant = simplify_variant_alleles(cohort_obj["variant"])
            if s_candidate.start == s_cohort_variant.start && s_candidate.reference_bases == s_cohort_variant.reference_bases
                ref_allele = s_candidate.reference_bases
                dict_allele_frequency[ref_allele] = get_ref_allele_frequency(s_cohort_variant)
            end
        end

        ref_allele = candidate.reference_bases
        if !haskey(dict_allele_frequency, ref_allele)
            dict_allele_frequency[ref_allele] = 1.0
        end
    end

    return dict_allele_frequency
end

function find_matching_allele_frequency(variant::Variant, population_vcf_reader::VcfReader, ref_reader::IndexedFastaReader, padding_bases::Int=0)
    query_region = make_range(
        variant.reference_name,
        variant.start - padding_bases,
        variant.end + padding_bases
    )

    cohort_variants = Vector{Variant}()
    try
        cohort_variants = query(population_vcf_reader, query_region)
    catch e
        if isa(e, ArgumentError) && occursin("NOT_FOUND: Unknown reference_name", string(e))
            contig_name = variant.reference_name
            @warn "population_vcf does not have config $contig_name"
            cohort_variants = Vector{Variant}()
        else
            rethrow(e)
        end
    end

    dict_allele_frequency = Dict{String, Float64}()
    for alt_base in variant.alternate_bases
        dict_allele_frequency[alt_base] = 0.0
    end

    try
        reference_haplotype, reference_offset = get_ref_haplotype_and_offset(variant, cohort_variants, ref_reader)
        candidate_haps = update_haplotype(variant, reference_haplotype, reference_offset)
        cohort_haps = Vector{Dict{String, Any}}()
        for cohort_variant in cohort_variants
            cohort_haps_updated = update_haplotype(cohort_variant, reference_haplotype, reference_offset)
            append!(cohort_haps, cohort_haps_updated)
        end

        for c in candidate_haps
            @debug "candidate $(c["haplotype"]), $(c["alt"])"
        end
        for c in cohort_haps
            @debug "cohort    $(c["haplotype"]), $(c["alt"])"
        end

        dict_allele_frequency = match_candidate_and_cohort_haplotypes(candidate_haps, cohort_haps)

        if !isempty(dict_allele_frequency)
            @debug "dict_allele_frequency: $(variant.reference_name):$(variant.start)-$(variant.end), $(variant.reference_bases) > $dict_allele_frequency" maxlog=3
        end
    catch e
        if isa(e, ArgumentError)
            dict_allele_frequency = Dict{String, Float64}()
            dict_allele_frequency[variant.reference_bases] = 1.0
            for alt in variant.alternate_bases
                dict_allele_frequency[alt] = 0.0
            end
            return dict_allele_frequency
        else
            rethrow(e)
        end
    end

    return dict_allele_frequency
end

function make_population_vcf_readers(population_vcf_filenames::Vector{String})
    if length(population_vcf_filenames) == 1
        reader = VcfReader(population_vcf_filenames[1])
        return Dict{String, VcfReader}(k => reader for k in keys(reader.header.contigs))
    end

    population_vcf_readers = Dict{String, Union{VcfReader, Nothing}}()
    for vcf_filename in population_vcf_filenames
        population_vcf_reader = VcfReader(vcf_filename)
        reference_name = ""
        for var in population_vcf_reader
            reference_name = var.reference_name
            break
        end
        if haskey(population_vcf_readers, reference_name) && population_vcf_readers[reference_name] !== nothing
            throw(ArgumentError("Variants on $reference_name are included in multiple VCFs"))
        end
        population_vcf_readers[reference_name] = population_vcf_reader
    end
    return population_vcf_readers
end

function add_allele_frequencies_to_candidates(candidates, population_vcf_reader::Union{VcfReader, Nothing}, ref_reader::IndexedFastaReader)
    updated_candidates = Vector{DeepVariantCall}()
    for candidate in candidates
        if population_vcf_reader !== nothing
            dict_allele_frequency = find_matching_allele_frequency(
                candidate.variant,
                population_vcf_reader,
                ref_reader
            )
        else
            dict_allele_frequency = Dict{String, Float64}()
            dict_allele_frequency[candidate.variant.reference_bases] = 1.0
            for alt in candidate.variant.alternate_bases
                dict_allele_frequency[alt] = 0.0
            end
        end
        push!(updated_candidates, DeepVariantCall(candidate.variant, candidate.allele_support, dict_allele_frequency))
    end
    return updated_candidates
end
```
